HoverColors.UI.Title: Hover Colors
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.Info: See Options menu to turn off tooltips.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.InfoDisabled:
Yellow = tooltips off.
Click (i) to enable.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.CollapsePanel:
Collapse panel to outline row only.
Click again expands to full panel.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.HoverToggle:
Highlights On/Off.
OFF hides normal highlights.
Clicking an object still shows your Outline color.
Good for panning the city quietly.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.Close:
Close panel. Default hotkey: J.
Game top-left icon On/Off.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.ResetOutline: Outline, click to reset to Game Default color
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.OutlineThickness:
Outline thickness.
1.0 = vanilla. Lower thinner, higher thicker.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.OwnerSwatch:
Owner/parent building highlight.
Example: bus depot. Green is game default.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.ResetFill: Fill, click to reset to Game Default
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.FillSwatch:
Fill color inside the highlight.
White = same as the Outline.
Picker's alpha bar sets opacity.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.FillOpacity: FILL opacity of area inside the border.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.ResetGuidelines:
GUIDELINES - tap to swap all 3 colors
+ opacity between vanilla and your custom picks.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.GuidelinesDashedC:
Dashed road/alignment guide color + opacity.
4th alpha bar syncs with the opacity slider.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.GuidelinesOpacity:
Dashed guide line opacity (alpha).
Synced with the dashed swatch alpha bar.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.GuidelinesColor: Large guide circles / spacing lines color + opacity.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.SpecializedIndust: Hide Extractor Lot area preview fill.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.Preset1:
Set 1 - tap to use, hold 0.5s to save.
Hotkey K switches 1 or 2.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.Preset2:
Set 2 - tap to use, hold 0.5s to save.
Hotkey K switches 1 or 2.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.ResetPresets:
⇔ Switch Set A (1+2) and Set B (1+2).
4 sets total. Hold 1 or 2 to save.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.RestorePresetDefa:
↺ Swap between mod default presets and your saved colors.
8 slots: 4 defaults, 4 yours.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.DistrictColors:
District overlay + border color/opacity.
Hold 0.5s to reset to game color.
HoverColors.UI.Tooltip.ResetDistrictColo: Reset all districts to the game's default blue.
